intent.notes: Lunch-break aerobic base, about 55 min: 35 min steady Zone 2 on an inclined treadmill, then floor core (hollow hold, arch hold) and optional hip mobility. On the walk the heart rate is the target; speed and incline are only the way to get there: start easy and adjust them to stay inside the band shown on the exercise. The core is two short floor holds, front and back of the trunk, with no equipment; a tested athlete gets his own hollow and posterior-chain ladder levels instead. No finger or elbow load and a low recovery cost, so it fits next to any climbing day.

modules.notes: Steady Zone 2 incline walk, 35 min. The heart rate is the target, speed and incline are the knobs. The first 5 min are the warm-up: start slow and let the heart rate settle into the zone. Hold the heart-rate band, not a speed: slow down if you drift above it.

Floor core after the walk, front of the trunk: hollow hold; a tested athlete gets his hollow ladder level instead. A family no other lunch pins: the lunches next to it in the rotation (HIIT, push) carry the rollout or the L-sit. No hanging.

prescription_overrides.notes: 3 x 30 s hollow hold: lower back pressed to the floor, arms by the ears, heels a hand off the floor. Shorten the lever (knees bent) before the back lifts.

modules.notes: Floor core, back of the trunk: arch hold, the antagonist of the hollow, on the floor so a gym with only a treadmill has it too; a tested athlete gets his posterior-chain ladder level instead (back extension where there is a bench). No side plank or Copenhagen here on purpose: the HIIT lunch next to it in the rotation carries the lateral chain.

prescription_overrides.notes: 3 x 15 s arch hold: face down, arms overhead, glutes squeezed, chest and thighs a few centimetres off the floor, eyes on the floor. Lift low and long, not high: no pinch in the lower back.

modules.notes: Optional hip mobility for high steps and heel hooks. Skip it if the lunch break is short.

prescription_overrides.notes: 8 min: hold each hip position 45-60 s, breathe deeply. Optional - skip it if the lunch break is short.
